DECLARATION OF MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE
IN SUPPORT OF PLAINTIFF’S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE SECOND AMENDED
AND SUPPLEMENTAL COMPLAINT

I, Marvelle J. Ballentine, declare as follows:

1. I am the Plaintiff in this action. I make this Declaration based upon my personal
knowledge. I am competent to testify to the matters stated herein.

2. My legal name is Marvelle J. Ballentine.

3. On July 4, 2022, Meta Platforms, Inc. invoked its Child Sexual Exploitation policy
against the Facebook account that I operated.

4. The Facebook account against which Meta invoked that policy was operated by me

under the name “Jay Ballentine.”

Case 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD Document 60-2 Filed 09/08/26 Page 3 of 4 PagelD#
639

5. Meta’s July 4, 2022 enforcement action was not issued against an account operated
by me under the name “Marvelle J. Ballentine.”

6. Before April 22, 2026, I never used the name “Marvelle J. Ballentine” to create,
register, identify, maintain, access, or operate any account on any product or service owned or
operated by Meta Platforms, Inc. that I used.

7. I never used “Marvelle J. Ballentine” as a username, profile name, display name,
account name, or other identity by which I identified myself on Facebook, Instagram, Threads,
WhatsApp, Oculus, Meta Quest, or any other Meta product or service that I used.

8. I did not provide “Marvelle J. Ballentine” to Meta Platforms, Inc. as the name
identifying me or any Meta account that I created, maintained, or operated.

9. In connection with my online identity, including my use of Meta products and
services, I used the name “Jay Ballentine,” rather than “Marvelle J. Ballentine.”

10. To the extent “Marvelle J. Ballentine” appeared in the April 9, 2026
correspondence, subpoena materials, or other litigation materials that I transmitted to the National
Center for Missing & Exploited Children, I included that name because it is my legal name and the
name under which the underlying federal litigation was pending. I did not include that name

because I had used it to identify or operate any Meta account.
